statement: The proposition declared as `Nat.Prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd` in the pinned Mathlib v4.30 source.

formal.statement: ∀ {p n : ℕ}, Nat.Prime p → (p.Coprime n ↔ ¬p ∣ n)
